106:         except Exception:
107:             self._baseline_scores_filename = None
108: 
109:         self._ignore_list = ["Data Descriptions"]
110:         # File names for datasets for which it is not obvious
111:         # key: from timeseriesclassification.com, value: right dataset name
112:         self._filenames = {
113:             "AtrialFibrillation": "AtrialFibrilation",
114:             "CinCECGtorso": "CinCECGTorso",
115:             "MixedShapes": "MixedShapesRegularTrain",
116:             "NonInvasiveFetalECGThorax1": "NonInvasiveFatalECGThorax1",
117:             "NonInvasiveFetalECGThorax2": "NonInvasiveFatalECGThorax2",
118:             "StarlightCurves": "StarLightCurves"
119:         }
120: 
121:     def baseline_accuracy(self, list_datasets=None, list_methods=None):
122:         """Report baseline performances as provided by UEA/UCR website (for
123:         univariate datasets only).
124: 
125:         Parameters
126:         ----------
127:         list_datasets: list or None (default: None)
128:             A list of strings indicating for which datasets performance should
129:             be reported.
130:             If None, performance is reported for all datasets.
131:         list_methods: list or None (default: None)
132:             A list of baselines methods for which performance should be
133:             reported.
134:             If None, performance for all baseline methods is reported.
135: 
136:         Returns
137:         -------
138:         dict
139:             A dictionary in which keys are dataset names and associated values
140:             are themselves dictionaries that provide accuracy scores for the
141:             requested methods.
142: 
143:         Examples
144:         --------
145:         >>> uea_ucr = UCR_UEA_datasets()
146:         >>> dict_acc = uea_ucr.baseline_accuracy(
147:         ...         list_datasets=["Adiac", "ChlorineConcentration"],
148:         ...         list_methods=["C45"])
149:         >>> len(dict_acc)
150:         2
151:         >>> dict_acc["Adiac"]  # doctest: +ELLIPSIS
152:         {'C45': 0.542199...}
153:         >>> all_dict_acc = uea_ucr.baseline_accuracy()
154:         >>> len(all_dict_acc)
155:         85
156:         """
157:         warnings.warn("The method baseline_accuracy will soon be deprecated because "
158:                       "the data provider no longer maintains this information.",
159:                       category=DeprecationWarning, stacklevel=2)
160:         with open(self._baseline_scores_filename, "r") as f:
161:             d_out = dict()
162:             for perfs_dict in csv.DictReader(f, delimiter=";"):
163:                 dataset_name = perfs_dict[""]
164:                 if list_datasets is None or dataset_name in list_datasets:
165:                     d_out[dataset_name] = {}
166:                     for m in perfs_dict.keys():
167:                         if m != "" and (list_methods is None or m in list_methods):
168:                             try:
169:                                 d_out[dataset_name][m] = float(perfs_dict[m])
170:                             except ValueError:  # Missing score case (score == "")
171:                                 pass
172:             return d_out
173: 
174:     def list_univariate_datasets(self):
175:         """List univariate datasets in the UCR/UEA archive.
176: 
177:         Examples
178:         --------
179:         >>> l = UCR_UEA_datasets().list_univariate_datasets()
180:         >>> len(l)
181:         128
182: 
183:         Returns
184:         -------
185:         list of str:
186:             A list of the names of all univariate datasets.
187:         """
188:         with open(self._list_univariate_filename, "r") as f:
189:             return [
190:                 infos_dict["problem"]  # get the dataset name
191:                 for infos_dict in csv.DictReader(f, delimiter=",")
192:             ]
193: 
194:     def list_multivariate_datasets(self):
195:         """List multivariate datasets in the UCR/UEA archive.
196: 
197:         Examples
198:         --------
199:         >>> l = UCR_UEA_datasets().list_multivariate_datasets()
200:         >>> "PenDigits" in l
201:         True
202: 
203:         Returns
204:         -------
205:         list of str:
206:             A list of the names of all multivariate dataset namas.
207:         """
208:         with open(self._list_multivariate_filename, "r") as f:
209:             return [
210:                 infos_dict["Problem"]  # get the dataset name
211:                 for infos_dict in csv.DictReader(f, delimiter=",")
212:             ]
213: 
214:     def list_datasets(self):
215:         """List datasets (both univariate and multivariate) available in the
216:         UCR/UEA archive.
217: 
218:         Examples
219:         --------
220:         >>> l = UCR_UEA_datasets().list_datasets()
221:         >>> "PenDigits" in l
222:         True
223:         >>> "BeetleFly" in l
224:         True
225:         >>> "DatasetThatDoesNotExist" in l
226:         False
227: 
228:         Returns
229:         -------
230:         list of str:
231:             A list of names of all (univariate and multivariate) dataset names.
232:         """
233:         return (self.list_univariate_datasets()
234:                 + self.list_multivariate_datasets())
235: 
236:     def list_cached_datasets(self):
237:         """List datasets from the UCR/UEA archive that are available in cache.
238: 
239:         Examples
240:         --------
241:         >>> beetlefly = UCR_UEA_datasets().load_dataset("BeetleFly")
242:         >>> l = UCR_UEA_datasets().list_cached_datasets()
243:         >>> "BeetleFly" in l
244:         True
245:         """
246:         return [path.name for path in self._data_dir.iterdir()
247:                 if path.is_dir() and path.name not in self._ignore_list]
248: 
249:     def load_dataset(self, dataset_name):
250:         """Load a dataset from the UCR/UEA archive from its name.
251: 
252:         On failure, `None` is returned for each of the four values and a
253:         `RuntimeWarning` is printed.
254: 
255:         Parameters
256:         ----------
257:         dataset_name : str
258:             Name of the dataset. Should be in the list returned by
259:             `list_datasets`
260: 
261:         Returns
